description: Small perimeter speed resolves absolute and percent values and honors threshold disabling.

mutants.description: The percent row must resolve 35% against the configured 50 mm/s outer-wall speed. Reading the raw value emits 35 mm/s and fails the independent parsed feed oracle; the absolute row remains a retained control.

The zero-threshold control must retain ordinary outer-wall speed. Removing the loop-length/threshold predicate applies the 15 mm/s small speed despite small_perimeter_threshold=0 and fails the control row.
